Ukraine Launches Major Drone Attacks on Russia, Targeting Industrial Sites

Ukraine launched one of its largest drone attacks on Russia, targeting industrial sites including a rocket and space center in the Samara region. At least six people were reported killed in the strikes. Ukrainian forces also claimed advances in Dnipropetrovsk. Russia has intensified ballistic missile attacks, with one strike in Kramatorsk killing two and injuring 17. The attacks come amid concerns about Black Sea food supply threats due to Russian strikes.
